title: Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection - Evaluating Responses - Clarifications
subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: During an RFP evaluation, the procurement officer emails a vendor to ask if the '100 hours' listed on page 5 was a typo and should have read '1,000 hours' to match the pricing table. The vendor is not allowed to change their price. This communication is called a:
questions.explain: Clarifications are limited exchanges between the government and proposers intended to resolve minor clerical errors or ambiguities without allowing the vendor to alter their proposal or price.
